obdble_connection_failed_checklist:
Please check the following:

• Is the OBD dongle properly plugged into your car's OBD port?
• Is your car turned on or in accessory mode?
• Is the OBD dongle connected to another app? If so, disconnect it first.
• Try removing the dongle and reinserting it.
• Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on your device.
• Try restarting the Bluetooth on your device.

If the problem persists, please report a bug.

tesla_transition_basic_description:
Tesla is changing their car connection service and will start charging money for data updates. Starting February 1st, your Tesla live data will switch to basic mode (SoC updates every 5 minutes) unless you upgrade to ABRP Premium. With Premium you get:

• Real-time live data
• Calibration of your vehicle's consumption
• Live speed data
• Estimation of battery degradation
• Vehicle, outside and battery temperature
• ... and all the other Premium features
tesla_transition_streaming_description: Due to Tesla's new connection service charges, you need to enable Tesla live data streaming to continue to receive live data from Tesla.
tesla_free_limitations_description: With a free account, Tesla live data is limited to SoC updates every 5 minutes. Upgrade to Premium to get real-time live data, consumption calibration, speed data, and more.
